notes: Official DJI STEP, Creo export by daisy.huang 2019-05-06. Gearbox IS separable: it is product subassembly '2_ASM' (occt-import-js node '2_ASM', meshes 26-40). Part names are generic numbers because Creo stripped the Chinese names; roles above are inferred from geometry. The tessellated bbox Y extent (140.9) includes the 3-phase leads. Reduction ratio 3591/187 per user guide. No colours embedded in the STEP.
